/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Microduck robotd (v0.3 read-only commissioning)
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=exec
User=root
Group=radxa
ExecStart=/opt/robot/daemon/current/bin/robotd --params /etc/robot/feetech-ft5/robotd.toml --socket /run/robotd.sock --read-only
Environment=ORT_DYLIB_PATH=/opt/robot/onnxruntime/1.28.0/libonnxruntime.so.1.28.0
Environment=RUST_LOG=info
RuntimeDirectory=robotd
Restart=no
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/30-.text:
# Studio commissioning drop-in; operator confirmed support on 2026-10-31.
# Commissioning startup actively turns servo torque OFF. Support the robot first.
# It does not run policy motion. Use only after the operator confirms support.
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/opt/robot/daemon/current/bin/robotd --params /etc/robot/feetech-ft5/robotd.toml --socket /run/robotd.sock --commissioning
